condition: betaln(a, b) returns NaN when min(a,b) is huge (≳1e100) and the ratio of the arguments exceeds 1e6, and is only ~1e-9 accurate for large unequal arguments.
workaround: For very large unequal arguments, compute log B(a,b) yourself with an asymptotic expansion in b/a (e.g. lgamma(b) - b*log(a) plus small correction terms), or use jax.scipy.special.betaln or mpmath.
